model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each criterion as relevant. The vertical axis displays the criterion labels – “Relevant FCs”, “FC Summary”, “Relevance Explanation”, “Clarity and Simplicity”, “Overall Summary”, “Filters”, “Veracity Explanation” – in that order from top to bottom. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each criterion is represented by a solid-colored bar; “Relevant FCs” is the tallest, extending to a value of 6, while “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” are the shortest, each reaching a value of 1. The bars are arranged in descending order based on the number of participants, and all bars are the same color, varying from dark purple to light green. Each bar is labeled with its corresponding numerical value at the right end.
